entries.source: Premium 30-minute helicopter flight over Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach, Red Tower, marina, Mediterranean coastline and Taurus Mountains. Price €250. Hotel transfer, certified pilot, briefing and insurance included.
entries.translation: Premium 30-minute helicopter flight over Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach, Red Tower, marina, Mediterranean coastline and Taurus Mountains. Price €250. Hotel transfer, certified pilot, briefing and insurance included.

entries.source: A premium 30-minute aerial journey above Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach, the Red Tower and the Mediterranean coastline.
entries.translation: A premium 30-minute aerial journey above Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach, the Red Tower and the Mediterranean coastline.

entries.source: Discover Alanya from a breathtaking bird’s-eye view with a luxury helicopter flight over the turquoise sea, historic coastline, yacht marina and the Taurus Mountains.
entries.translation: Discover Alanya from a breathtaking bird’s-eye view with a luxury helicopter flight over the turquoise sea, historic coastline, yacht marina and the Taurus Mountains.

entries.source: is a premium 30-minute sightseeing experience offering panoramic views of Alanya and the Mediterranean coastline from the air.
entries.translation: is a premium 30-minute sightseeing experience offering panoramic views of Alanya and the Mediterranean coastline from the air.

entries.source: The planned route includes views of Alanya Castle and the historic peninsula, Cleopatra Beach, the Red Tower, the harbour, the coastline and the Taurus Mountains. The exact route may change according to weather, air traffic and operational conditions.
entries.translation: The planned route includes views of Alanya Castle and the historic peninsula, Cleopatra Beach, the Red Tower, the harbour, the coastline and the Taurus Mountains. The exact route may change according to weather, air traffic and operational conditions.

entries.source: Before departure, guests receive a safety briefing and boarding instructions. The experience is suitable for sightseeing, romantic occasions, marriage proposals and private photo or video projects arranged in advance.
entries.translation: Before departure, guests receive a safety briefing and boarding instructions. The experience is suitable for sightseeing, romantic occasions, marriage proposals and private photo or video projects arranged in advance.

entries.source: Pickup from your hotel or apartment address. The exact time is confirmed after booking according to the scheduled flight slot.
entries.translation: Pickup from your hotel or apartment address. The exact time is confirmed after booking according to the scheduled flight slot.

entries.source: Comfortable transfer to the helicopter departure point and arrival at the designated passenger meeting area.
entries.translation: Comfortable transfer to the helicopter departure point and arrival at the designated passenger meeting area.

entries.source: Passenger check-in, seat assignment and mandatory briefing about approaching the aircraft, boarding, restraints and emergency procedures.
entries.translation: Passenger check-in, seat assignment and mandatory briefing about approaching the aircraft, boarding, restraints and emergency procedures.

entries.source: Boarding is completed only under crew supervision. Personal items are secured and all passengers are seated with restraints fastened.
entries.translation: Boarding is completed only under crew supervision. Personal items are secured and all passengers are seated with restraints fastened.

entries.source: Fly above Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach, the Red Tower, marina, Mediterranean coastline and the Taurus Mountains.
entries.translation: Fly above Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach, the Red Tower, marina, Mediterranean coastline and the Taurus Mountains.

entries.source: After landing and leaving the aircraft under crew supervision, return transfer is provided to the original pickup point.
entries.translation: After landing and leaving the aircraft under crew supervision, return transfer is provided to the original pickup point.

entries.source: Customer meeting point: hotel or apartment address.
entries.translation: Customer meeting point: hotel or apartment address.

entries.source: Exact pick-up time is confirmed after reservation according to the flight schedule.
entries.translation: Exact pick-up time is confirmed after reservation according to the flight schedule.

entries.source: How long does the helicopter experience take?
entries.translation: How long does the helicopter experience take?

entries.source: The flight itself lasts approximately 30 minutes. The total experience is longer because it also includes hotel transfer, check-in, preparation and the safety briefing.
entries.translation: The flight itself lasts approximately 30 minutes. The total experience is longer because it also includes hotel transfer, check-in, preparation and the safety briefing.

entries.source: Yes. Pick-up and return transfer from your hotel or apartment address are included. The exact time is confirmed after reservation according to the flight schedule.
entries.translation: Yes. Pick-up and return transfer from your hotel or apartment address are included. The exact time is confirmed after reservation according to the flight schedule.

entries.source: Do children pay a reduced price?
entries.translation: Do children pay a reduced price?

entries.source: No. Every passenger occupies an individual seat, so children pay the full price. Availability and passenger requirements are confirmed before booking.
entries.translation: No. Every passenger occupies an individual seat, so children pay the full price. Availability and passenger requirements are confirmed before booking.

entries.source: Can the flight be arranged for a proposal or photo shoot?
entries.translation: Can the flight be arranged for a proposal or photo shoot?

entries.source: Yes. Romantic organization, professional photo or video shooting and individual requests can be arranged separately, subject to availability and an additional charge.
entries.translation: Yes. Romantic organization, professional photo or video shooting and individual requests can be arranged separately, subject to availability and an additional charge.

entries.source: Can the schedule or route change?
entries.translation: Can the schedule or route change?

entries.source: Yes. Flight time and route may be adjusted for operational, aviation or weather conditions. Final details are confirmed before departure.
entries.translation: Yes. Flight time and route may be adjusted for operational, aviation or weather conditions. Final details are confirmed before departure.

entries.source: Message us on WhatsApp — we will confirm availability, flight schedule, transfer details and VIP organization options.
entries.translation: Message us on WhatsApp — we will confirm availability, flight schedule, transfer details and VIP organization options.

entries.source: Passengers must attend the safety briefing and follow all pilot and ground-crew instructions during approach, boarding, flight, landing and disembarkation.
entries.translation: Passengers must attend the safety briefing and follow all pilot and ground-crew instructions during approach, boarding, flight, landing and disembarkation.

entries.source: Approach only when instructed, use the route shown by the crew and never walk behind the helicopter or near the tail rotor.
entries.translation: Approach only when instructed, use the route shown by the crew and never walk behind the helicopter or near the tail rotor.

entries.source: Secure hats, scarves, bags, jewellery, phones, selfie sticks and camera straps. Carry personal items low and never raise objects above your head near the aircraft.
entries.translation: Secure hats, scarves, bags, jewellery, phones, selfie sticks and camera straps. Carry personal items low and never raise objects above your head near the aircraft.

entries.source: The pilot may delay, reroute, reschedule or cancel the flight when weather, technical or operational conditions do not allow safe operation.
entries.translation: The pilot may delay, reroute, reschedule or cancel the flight when weather, technical or operational conditions do not allow safe operation.

entries.source: Safety has priority over the advertised schedule and route. The operator’s aircraft-specific briefing, safety card and crew instructions always take priority.
entries.translation: Safety has priority over the advertised schedule and route. The operator’s aircraft-specific briefing, safety card and crew instructions always take priority.
